_comment: Fixture manifest for P4DB-5 Tushare corporate-action tests. Each entry maps a raw response body file (the verbatim proxy JSON envelope, no wrapper) to the api_name + params that produced it and the HTTP status observed. The loader reads body['data'] as the {fields, items} payload.

_provenance.canonical_consistency_check: smart_beta.vendors.tushare.proxy_client.record_fixture: three identical samples per request; every non-empty payload had to agree byte-for-byte or TushareNonDeterministicResponseError would have aborted the recording.
_provenance.not_evidence_for: Direct official Tushare API behavior. These bodies are the third-party proxy's real delivered data, not a capture from the paid official Tushare service; nothing here certifies official-API behavior at any point tier.
_provenance.credential_note: TUSHARE_PROXY_TOKEN was present in the implementation environment. The token is sent only in the X-API-Key header and never appears in any request params, response body, manifest, or test. The recording CLI prints request params only.
